verdict.rationale: Martin is a cloud personal-assistant service, and a product of this kind could plausibly offer an API or headless mode, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only conversational interfaces (phone, SMS, email, Slack, a desktop app) and vendor-run background tasks such as briefings and email triage. Nothing shows a CLI, API, or headless/CI invocation, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.
